nearMe.answer: Atlantis NDT does not run walk-in training centres. Courses are primarily self-paced online, with enrolment throughout the year and Level III support for clarifications. Access opens the moment you enrol. Company teams can discuss on-site or blended delivery. Hands-on training, equipment and the practical examination must be arranged separately under your employer’s written practice. We support technicians and employers worldwide, from offices in Houston (USA) and Hyderabad (India).
formats: Self-paced theory with Level III support

Join at any time of year and work through the learning material around your schedule. Level III support is available throughout the year for course clarifications; confirm contact arrangements when you enrol.
For company crews: the instructor brings reference specimens and calibration blocks to your site, trains on your own equipment, and runs the practical sessions there.
Self-paced online theory first, then a practical block at your facility under an ASNT Level III.
Discuss the methods, levels, shift patterns and instructor availability before agreeing an on-site course.
The Practical NDT simulator for hands-on method practice in the browser. It is practice only, not a substitute for the practical examination.
nearMe.certAnswer: Under ASNT SNT-TC-1A your employer certifies you, not a test centre: you complete the classroom hours, the on-the-job experience and the general, specific and practical examinations, and the employer issues the certification under its written practice. Atlantis delivers the training and the Level III-administered examinations wherever your crew works. ASNT's own central certifications, such as ASNT NDT Level III, are booked through ASNT's testing arrangements, not through Atlantis.

cityCourses.intro: Each course is ASNT SNT-TC-1A training at Level I or Level II, led by an ASNT NDT Level III and delivered online (primarily self-paced, with access from the moment you enrol), on-site at your facility in {label}, or blended. The hours below are the SNT-TC-1A recommended minimums for classroom training and on-the-job experience; your employer's written practice sets the binding figures.
cityCourses.caption: SNT-TC-1A recommended hours by method and level

cityCourses.advanced: PAUT and TOFD build on conventional UT Level II; their hours are set by your written practice. See PAUT Level 2 training and TOFD training. ASNT Level III candidates can take ASNT Level III exam preparation.
practical: Theory is primarily self-paced online with Level III support. Instructor-led and on-site options for company teams are agreed separately.
Practical training runs on real specimens at your employer's facility. For on-site courses the instructor brings reference specimens and calibration blocks and trains on your own equipment.
The practical examination is administered by an ASNT Level III on real specimens under your employer's written practice. Atlantis does not run a training or exam centre in {label}.
Between sessions, practise on the Practical NDT simulator (practice only, not a substitute for the practical examination).

canada.h2: For Canadian NDT companies: ASNT SNT-TC-1A training, Level III services and the Atlantis ERP
canada.intro: Atlantis NDT provides ASNT SNT-TC-1A training and certification for Canadian employers whose customers, contracts or codes call for it: Level I and Level II courses in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT, plus PAUT and TOFD, Level III exam preparation, and examinations by our ASNT NDT Level III under your written practice, with you as the certifying employer. Canadian NDT companies also use our outsourced Level III services and the Atlantis ERP.
items: Courses, examinations and certification records for your crew under your SNT-TC-1A written practice.
Outsourced Level III, SNT-TC-1A written practices, procedure development and approval, and audit support, delivered remotely or on-site.
Programme, procedure and audit support for Canadian inspection companies, fabricators and asset owners.
Technician certifications, equipment calibration, jobs, quoting and invoicing in one system. Plans for the USA and Canada are published on the ERP pricing page.

hyderabad.description: ASNT SNT-TC-1A NDT training for Hyderabad technicians and employers, led by an ASNT NDT Level III: online, primarily self-paced theory and practical sessions at your facility.
hyderabad.h1: NDT Training in Hyderabad — ASNT SNT-TC-1A Courses Led by an ASNT NDT Level III
hyderabad.intro: Atlantis NDT has an office in Hyderabad. NDT training for technicians and employers in Hyderabad and Telangana is ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level I and Level II in UT, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET, plus ASNT Level III exam preparation. Theory is online and primarily self-paced, and a company team can have the course and its practical sessions run on-site at its own facility. Atlantis does not run training centres.
hyderabad.leadBy: Training is led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III in five methods (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT), with 11+ years of international NDT field experience.
hyderabad.coursesIntro: Level I and Level II courses are training and examination under your employer's SNT-TC-1A written practice: the employer issues the certification. Level III is exam preparation only; ASNT examines and certifies Level III through its own testing arrangements.
levels: Entry level in one method or as the five-method package. Prerequisites: high-school education or equivalent and an annual near-vision check.
Independent setup, interpretation and reporting in the method. Prerequisites: Level I in the method (or the combined hours) and documented on-the-job experience.
Preparation for the ASNT Basic and method examinations. Training only; ASNT certifies.
hyderabad.practicalH2: How are practical sessions arranged in Hyderabad?
hyderabad.office: Atlantis NDT, {address}, India. Courses run online or on-site at your facility rather than at the office, so please send an enquiry before visiting.
hyderabad.otherSchemes: Atlantis trains to ASNT SNT-TC-1A only. ISO 9712 and PCN certifications are sat through their own accredited bodies, and industrial radiography licensing in India is handled by the regulator, not by a training provider; Atlantis does not deliver or examine any of them.
hyderabad.faqH2: Frequently asked questions: NDT training in Hyderabad
faq: Is there an Atlantis NDT office in Hyderabad?
Yes. The Hyderabad office is at {address}. It is not a walk-in training centre: courses run online or on-site at your facility, so send an enquiry first.
Can I complete NDT practical training in Hyderabad?

Yes, at your employer's facility. For on-site courses the instructor brings reference specimens and calibration blocks and trains on your own equipment, and the practical examination is administered by an ASNT Level III under your employer's written practice.
Which NDT methods can I train in?
UT, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET at Level I and Level II, with PAUT and TOFD for technicians who hold conventional UT Level II or equivalent documented UT experience.
How much does NDT training cost in Hyderabad?
Fees for India are quoted for your methods, levels and number of trainees. Send the details and we reply within one business day.

Under SNT-TC-1A your employer issues the Level I or Level II certification under its written practice, once the training, experience and examinations are complete. ASNT Level III is certified by ASNT.
